articles.summary: NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”), a leader in expanding self-service financial access for financial institutions, retailers and consumers, today announced that Bank Pekao S.A., one of the largest financial institutions in Central and Eastern Europe, has selected the Atleos Authentic™ payment switching platform as part of its card payment processing infrastructure modernization strategy.
articles.title: NCR Atleos selected by Bank Pekao S.A. to modernize card payment processing infrastructure with Authentic switch
